race.description: Nijinsky Standing At Yirribee Stud Pace
race.comment: POSTER PERFECT (6) has been racing well of late. Came from wider and finished fourth at her latest appearance at this venue, beaten 6 metres. The lower draw gives her winning claims. MY DARLING DANCER (5) is back from a spell of 14 months but looks to be right up to the mark following a placing in a recent trial. Winner at Maryborough two back. Look for a good return. MY LINE OF FIRE (1) was held up from a back row draw when fourth at his most recent appearance at Young. Should get his chance from the ace draw. SHES GOT A REASON (4) draws lower and is suited coming back back in grade.
